title: Bootstrap Fashion
tagline: A ten-page fashion storefront, ready to brand
description: A complete fashion retail front end: homepage, category listing with live filters and a price slider, product page with gallery and reviews, cart, and a three-step checkout with shipping and payment. Built on Bootstrap 5, so your colours, type and logo go in without rewriting anything. Front end only — it drops onto whatever commerce backend you already use, or we wire one up.
highlights: Ten finished pages, including the whole checkout flow
Category filters, price slider, product gallery and reviews already built
Every form validates: required fields marked, 197 countries in the address picker
Mobile-first — checked at phone width on every page, no sideways scroll
Your brand in a variables file: colours, fonts and logo, no rewrite
Static pages — fast to host anywhere, nothing to keep patched

credit.name: Pixel Rocket
credit.note: A third-party template, shown as a starting point we customise — not as our own build.
